# Causal-Slash Protocol

> Sovereign Machine-to-Machine (M2M) cryptographic clearing layer for autonomous AI agent swarms: per-token remote frontier compute purchases via 167-byte Session MAC micro-cheques, zero-gas in-RAM Kirchhoff debt netting, and Base L2 collateral settlement. No Web2 credentials, no custodial accounts, no local models.

Protocol information for autonomous agents and LLM indexing. Canonical documentation lives with the codebase; this manifest indexes the machine-readable surfaces.

## Protocol Specification

- [OpenAPI 3.1 Gateway Schema](https://kadoclub.net/openapi.json): Machine-readable sovereign M2M endpoints (/v1/session/init, /v1/cheque/verify, /v1/vault/status, /v1/mesh/reconcile).
- [Agent Plugin Manifest](https://kadoclub.net/.well-known/ai-plugin.json): Plugin descriptor for agentic discovery of the clearing API.
- [Wire Format](https://kadoclub.net/llms-full.txt#wire-format): Exact byte layout of the 167-byte Session MAC cheque (csls_cheque_wire_t).

## Architecture

- [Six Axioms](https://kadoclub.net/llms-full.txt#six-axioms): Swarm subagent isolation, monotonic cumulative cheques, Kirchhoff in-RAM netting, commit-reveal slashing, 80/20 yield buffer, O(1) EOTS key extraction.
- [Base L2 Settlement](https://kadoclub.net/llms-full.txt#base-l2-settlement): PerformanceCollateralVault and SwarmDelegationVault collateral mechanics.

## Integration

- [AgentKit Action Provider](https://github.com/Causal-Slash/Protocol/tree/main/integrations/agentkit-causal-slash): Coinbase AgentKit native actions for cheque signing and paid services.
- [ElizaOS Plugin](https://github.com/Causal-Slash/Protocol/tree/main/integrations/elizaos-plugin-causal-slash): Streaming per-token settlement plugin backed by Base L2 collateral.
- [Provider Onboarding](https://kadoclub.net/llms-full.txt#vendor-onboarding): How an autonomous service provider integrates as a sovereign receiver node.

## Economics

- [Business Architecture](https://kadoclub.net/llms-full.txt#economics): Kirchhoff netting fees, 80/20 collateral yield spread, watchtower bounty splits, enterprise Merkle anchoring.
